method.interpolation: distance-weighted circular mean of the doubled azimuth
method.note: SHmax is an axis: every mean is taken on 2*theta and halved. Cells with no data within the radius, or whose data disagree, are transparent rather than filled.

colour.quantity: SHmax azimuth, degrees clockwise from north
colour.alpha: resultant length (agreement) of the data in the cell

source.name: World Stress Map Database Release 2016
source.citation: Heidbach, O., Rajabi, M., Reiter, K., Ziegler, M., WSM Team (2016): World Stress Map Database Release 2016. V. 1.1. GFZ Data Services.

variants.shmax: orientation of the maximum horizontal stress, hue cyclic over 180°
variants.regime: dominant faulting regime — red normal, green strike-slip, blue thrust
variants.agreement: resultant length: how consistently the records in a cell agree
variants.density: effective C-quality measurements within the radius, log scale
